title: Gradient worlds palette
slide_intent: Compare color relationships as environments rather than isolated chips so their scale and contrast are visible.
strategic_value: A varied but recurring spatial treatment can express Channel 4’s eclectic programming while keeping the backgrounds related.
demonstration: An edge-to-edge grid compares many recessed gradient rooms, with warm, cool, pale and dark combinations.
practical_value: Select a gradient relationship by comparing the mood and depth of complete fields.

content_islands.name: Comparison grid
content_islands.spec: Fill the board with adjacent room-shaped gradients at matching tile sizes.

content_islands.name: Color variation
content_islands.spec: Preserve the changes in hue, contrast and light placement across the grid.

reference_purposes.Expression: The grid demonstrates a broad range of colored gradient rooms.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram says the eclectic gradient spectrum expresses Channel 4’s diversity and mischievous character.

ingredient.name: Gradient world palette
ingredient.role: Provide varied environments with a shared spatial form.
ingredient.application: Compare complete gradient rooms rather than treating the displayed colors as flat swatches.
ingredient.scope: These are case-study examples, not a numbered palette or prescribed usage ratio.
